purpose: Versioned record of chemistry families for which a completed DIRECT temperature sweep has verified that the local shared thermal-response shape transfers. This registry is the only exemption path for the M-ANCHOR admissibility rule of the Agent V5 chemistry-domain gate.
admission_rule: An entry may be added only after a completed direct M-SWEEP measurement on the same chemistry family.
The entry must name the measurement record, the verification date and the numeric criterion that was met.
A model, a planner argument, a prompt or an Agent deliberation can never add an entry.
Adding an entry is a versioned repository change and must increment this file's version.
criterion_for_verified_transfer: The apparent temperature-response descriptor E_eta of the modified chemistry lies inside the measured local band 42.05 +/- 2.43 kJ/mol, and one-point reconstruction of the 120-130 C response from a 110 C anchor stays within the pooled multiplicative error of 1.088x.
state_at_v5_implementation: No resin-modified chemistry family has a completed direct sweep. Every chemistry-shifted candidate therefore requires M-SWEEP verification before M-ANCHOR becomes admissible.
